summary: Regression pass for SpiderNetOS Cockpit (Vue 3 + FastAPI mock). Backend: 25/25 pytest cases pass against the public preview URL. Frontend: login → / redirect, role-gated workspace pivots, and 17 of 18 documented routes verified rendering the shell; /platform/ste was not reached only because Cloudflare's bot-challenge interstitial kicked in at the very end of the playwright run (CAPTCHA screenshot captured). Logout clears localStorage token and returns to /login. No app-level blockers found.
action_items: Optional: investigate the single 'Failed to load resource: 401' console line observed during route hopping — likely an unauthenticated /api/auth/me call somewhere; verify api.js attaches the bearer token before the call. Cosmetic only, no UX impact observed.

Optional: many noisy console errors ('TrustedHTML', 'TrustedScript', CSP inline-script blocks, WebGL stalls, Cloudflare preload warnings) are emitted by the preview iframe environment, not by the cockpit code; consider silencing them in dev-tools doc but they are not real defects.
critical_code_review_comments: App.vue is large (~470 lines) — could split icons map and breadcrumb map into a small module for readability, but not a blocker.

auth.js switchRole only mutates the principal client-side; capabilities and role are derived locally. This is documented as demo-only in the file header; the TODO to swap for Sanctum is in place — acceptable for the mock cockpit MVP.
Backend mock allows empty role to fall back to super_admin via an in-pydantic default; the explicit guard `role if body.role in CAP_BY_ROLE else 'super_admin'` is defensive and correct.
Mongo is not used in this mock backend (FastAPI in-memory) — that's fine for a frontend cockpit demo and matches the stated architecture.
Frontend uses VITE_API_URL (Vite, not CRA) so the system's REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL convention does not apply; ingress routing on /api/* still works correctly through the public preview URL.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/cockpit_api_test.py (new pytest regression suite — 25 cases covering health, auth + role honoring, list-envelope shape on 8 endpoints, singleton endpoints, atlas chat, onboarding step, approve/reject)

success_rate.frontend: 94% (17/18 routes verified; /platform/ste blocked by Cloudflare challenge at end of run, not an app bug)

test_credentials: Any email/password works. Used operator@acme.ops / demo / role super_admin (default).
seed_data_creation: None — backend serves static/in-memory mock data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/cockpit_api_test.py covers all critical /api/* contracts. Use `python -m pytest backend/tests/cockpit_api_test.py -v` from /app. For UI testing, bear in mind the preview URL is fronted by Cloudflare and may show a bot-challenge if you hit too many routes quickly — space goto() calls or accept the CAPTCHA may briefly appear. Login is fake (any creds work); the role picker on the login card and the role switcher under data-testid='role-switcher' both flow through authStore.switchRole / login(role) and re-derive capabilities client-side. Workspace pivots have data-testid 'workspace-pivot-{user|admin|platform}'. Logout button is data-testid='logout-button' inside the user menu (data-testid='user-menu-button').
rca of the issue: No blocking issues found. The only failure during the playwright run was a Page.goto timeout on /platform/ste; the captured screenshot shows a Cloudflare 'Performing security verification' page, indicating the preview's bot-mitigation layer triggered after ~15 successive navigations from the same headless browser. This is environmental, not an app defect; manual navigation to /platform/ste and the corresponding backend endpoint /api/platform/ste/matrix both return valid data (covered by TestSingletonEndpoints::test_platform_ste_matrix which passes).
